authority_hierarchy.effect: Adopts, rejects, defers, or authorizes within explicit scope.
Defines non-overridable governance invariants under Human authority.
Defines source, claim, domain, security, lifecycle, or runtime constraints.
Defines component ownership, public contracts, topology, and accepted tradeoffs.
Binds a specific governed design and generation input.
Defines behavior and responsibility within adopted higher artifacts.
Defines machine-checkable structure and legal transitions.
Executes approved design; cannot reverse-modify higher authority.

evidence_axis.role: Substantiates identity, input, action, validation, and decision claims; never adopts or overrides an artifact by itself.
